subject: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@heallex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning

Hi Olivia —

Congrats on the renew coming up next quarter. I wanted to start a short kickoff thread so we can align timeline, stakeholders, and the QBR slot. High level ask: confirm whether Heallex is comfortable with a 12-month term at the updated throughput tiers we discussed, or if you want to explore a staircase/commit path.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Customer to confirm primary decision owner and final attendee list (ops + finance).
- Redwood to share a mutual action plan (attached) with milestones: pricing, procurement redlines, QBR date, signed PO/DocuSign.
- Technical sync (30m) to validate burst capacity and migration windows.

QBR availability (please pick one):
- Tue 2026-12-21, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-12-23, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Tue 2027-01-04, 11:00–12:00 PT

Attachments: Renewal-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan, draft)

Thanks — happy to loop in Hannah from Product if we need a systems-level readout.

— Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwoodinference.com
From: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@heallex.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Hudson <mark.hudson@heallex.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@heallex.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning

Thanks Elliot — appreciate the clear outline. Quick responses inline: 

- Decision owner: Mark Hudson (CFO) will sign the commercial terms.
- Tech/ops lead: Priya Singh (Platform Ops) — she owns capacity testing.
- We prefer a 12-month commitment but would like a small trial window (60 days) for the new throughput tier before full activation.

QBR: the 2026-12-23 slot works best for our team (08:00–09:00 PT). Can you send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda?

I attached a usage export for November so you all can validate the headroom numbers.

— Olivia
Olivia Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Heallex
olivia.bennett@heallex.com
Attachment: Heallex-usage-Nov.csv
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@heallex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@heallex.com>, Mark Hudson <mark.hudson@heallex.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning

Perfect — locking 2026-12-23, 08:00–09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. Agenda (proposed):
1) Commercial overview & term options (5m) — Elliot
2) Mutual action plan walkthrough & milestones (10m) — Marissa
3) Capacity readout + trial window plan (15m) — Priya + David
4) Procurement/next steps & timelines (10m) — Olivia + Elliot

Operational ask for Heallex team before the call:
- Confirm the PO owner and expected approval lead time (for DocuSign routing).
- Any blocking compliance evidence required (we can include SOC2 artifacts during the QBR).

Notes: David, if Heallex is asking for a 60-day trial period before full activation, can you flag whether we should propose a conditional discount or a staged billing approach?

Attaching: Renewal-MAP-v1.pdf (updated with proposed dates)

— Elliot
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@heallex.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@heallex.com>, Mark Hudson <mark.hudson@heallex.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning

Adding CS context — brief notes for the QBR and MAP: 
- We'll propose a 60-day verification window during which Heallex can exercise a single downgrade/rollback if KPIs fall outside agreed thresholds; after verification we flip to the committed tier.
- For discounts: recommend a modest onboarding credit (one-time) rather than a recurring discount tied to the trial; easier for approvals.
- I will share the QBR slide deck draft by EOD 12/21.

David — please prep a short runbook for the trial (metrics to monitor, rollback criteria, and SRE contacts).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@heallex.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Hudson <mark.hudson@heallex.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@heallex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Heallex term & capacity planning

Thanks everyone — that plan looks sensible. Confirming: 12/23 QBR, include the SOC2 artifacts and the trial runbook. Mark will review commercial and sign once we land the final PO.

Mark (cc): we can review the commercial on the call; Elliot, please have the DocuSign ready post-QBR (we aim to finish approvals by 01/07).

Olivia
-- End of thread --
